generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details
The contractor /authorized signatory should attach his/her scanned signature to the schedule-B before uploading the document.
If any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever
corrigendum will be published only in the e-portal for all modifications and corrections if any.

The intending contractors should note that, if any of the lands (either in part / parts or in whole) required for the work is not yet acquired by the CADA, Bheemarayanagudi, it shall be the responsibility of the contractor to take possession of such land and start the work on his own risk and cost.

Contractor should abide by the directions of Government towards recovery of 1% (or as modification by Government from time to time) cess from the contractors bill under the provision of building and construction work welfare cess act-1996
The validity period of EMD shall be for a minimum period of 180 days, from the date of opening of tender

Successful bidder should execute the agreement Within 20 days from the date of Acceptance of tender. If the contractor fails to enter into the agreement within the said period, the EMD of the contractor shall be forfeited and action shall be initiated for banning to participate in the further tendering of KRISHNA CADA BHEEMARAYANAGUDI
The intending bidder shall upload self attested letter pad mentioning latest communication address, land phone & mobile Phone and e-mail address for communication.
The amount are excluding GST but inclusive of all other charges.
The increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by authority while granting the extension of time.
GST shall be paid to the tenderer amount separately.

The contractor are bound to abide by the statutory and mandatory rules and Regulations, mentioned in the latest circulars of MINES AND Geology Department, for minerals required execute the above works.
For the work done certificate, in respect of any of the above work application shall be submitted through Seva Sindhu e-portal after successful completion of the work/defect liability period.

All materials like Steel. Cement etc. required for the above work should be procured by the contractor only at his own cost. And these materials will have to be got tested by the component authority before put to use and certificate shall be submitted.

The intending contractors should note that, as the tender invited is on percentage basis, if the bid amount based on the percentage quoted by the contractor is less than the amount put to tender, the contractor shall submit the additional performance security amount equal to the difference between the amount put to tender and quoted amount through Nationalized Bank Demand Draft (DD)/FDR in favour of The Executive Engineer, KBJNL,FIC,DIVISION.NO-4AlmelTQ-Almel DIST- Vijayapur, at the time of agreement.

Contractors participating in this tendering process/who intent to submit their bids/bid should produce to this office all the Documents in Original (scanned copy of which they should upload) in e-portal.

During the time of technical evaluation, if the employer finds that any certificates / information furnished is false and fake, such bids will be disqualified and EMD shall be forfeited barred from the Participation of tendering process.
Upload All necessary technical documents as per tender document
All Terms and Conditions as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: A Certified copy of contractor registration issued by the KPWD.
Copy of the Income Tax Returns filed for the financial year 2025-26. Assessment year 2026-27
EPF registration certificate. The intending contractor should compulsorily register with EPF authorities.

The intending bidder in its name should have in the last 5 years i.e from 2021-22 to 2025-26, achieved in at least two financial years for other works & at least one financial year For SC or ST or CAT-I or CAT-IIA reserved works a minimum financial turnover of not less than the amount put to tender. The Annual Turnover certificate with UDIN from chartered accountant for any two years to be uploaded
The contractor should upload a statement of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed on their official letter head.

Eligible Tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under For others Assessed available tender capacity AxNx2.5 - B For SC,ST, CAT-I & CAT-II A Assessed available tender capacity AxNx5.00-B.
